description: Template for the search_stays tool surface, derived from fixtures/stays_near_cloud9.json. The components are fixed. siargao_mcp/stays.py adds one StayCard per result (from stayCard, with {i} replaced by the 0-based index and {n} by the 1-based index) and fills the data model. With no results it swaps stays-grid for emptyState.

copy.title: {count_label} near {area}
copy.subtitle: Sample prices per night, cheapest first.
copy.emptySubtitle: Nothing matched this budget. Try a higher max price.
copy.emptyNoteBodyCheaper: The cheapest sample stay near {area} is PHP {cheapest} per night. Raise the max price with the slider and search again.
copy.emptyNoteBodyUnknownArea: There are no sample stays for {area}. Try one of these areas: {areas}.

cloud 9.title: Book the boardwalk side
cloud 9.body: Stays on the Cloud 9 road are a short walk to the break and to food. Further inland is cheaper but you will want a scooter.
cloud 9.author: From a Siargao local

general luna.title: Stay near Tourism Road
general luna.body: General Luna is the town center, with cafes, the night market and boats to the islands. Cloud 9 is a short tricycle ride away.
general luna.author: From a Siargao local

pacifico.title: Plan the ride north
pacifico.body: Pacifico is a long ride from General Luna by van or scooter. Bring cash, there are few ATMs up north.
pacifico.author: From a Siargao local

pilar.title: Time it with the tide
pilar.body: The Magpupungko rock pools only show at low tide. Check the tide table before you head over.
pilar.author: From a Siargao local

burgos.title: Stock up before you go
burgos.body: Burgos is quiet and far from town. Bring cash and snacks, and plan your ride back before dark.
burgos.author: From a Siargao local

default.title: Rent a scooter
default.body: Most stays are spread along the coast road. A scooter is the easiest way to get between town, the breaks and the beaches.
default.author: From a Siargao local
